goal: Verify that a user can successfully create a new Site Host account and subsequently access the application settings menu.
instructions: On the 'Create your account' page, enter 'alice' into the 'Username' field.
Click the blue 'Sign up' button to submit the registration form.
Once logged into the main dashboard, click the settings icon (gear symbol) located in the top-right corner of the screen to open the settings menu.
success_criteria: The user is successfully redirected from the registration page to the main application dashboard.
The settings dropdown menu is visible and displays options such as 'Shown time' and 'Order'.
The main content area displays existing data (e.g., 'Meeting notes for Q3 planning') indicating a successful login.
No error messages are displayed during the account creation or menu navigation process.
